entries.es: Art. 27 RIA
entries.en: Art. 27 AI Act

entries.es:
Ser responsable del despliegue de un sistema de IA de alto riesgo que cumpla alguna de estas condiciones:
 (i) Sistemas de IA de alto riesgo que no estén en el Anexo III, punto 2 y sean desplegados por organismos de Derecho público o entidades privadas que presten servicios públicos.
 (ii) Sistemas de IA de alto riesgo del Anexo III, punto 5b): sistemas de evaluación de solvencia o calificación crediticia de personas físicas (excluyendo detección de fraude financiero).
 (iii) Sistemas de IA de alto riesgo del Anexo III, punto 5c): sistemas de evaluación de riesgos y fijación de precios en seguros de vida y de salud.
entries.en:
Being the deployer of a high-risk AI system that meets one of these conditions:
(i) High-risk AI systems not in point 2 of Annex III deployed by bodies governed by public law or private entities providing public services.
(ii) High-risk AI systems in point 5(b) of Annex III: systems for evaluating the creditworthiness or establishing the credit score of natural persons (excluding financial fraud detection).
(iii) High-risk AI systems in point 5(c) of Annex III: risk assessment and pricing systems for life and health insurance.

entries.es: Ser proveedor de modelo de IA de uso general
entries.en: Being the provider of a general-purpose AI model.

entries.es: El concepto de minimal risk del AI Act no equivale a bajo riesgo de ciberseguridad
entries.en: The AI Act's concept of minimal risk is not equivalent to low cybersecurity risk

entries.es: El AI Act no clasifica por superficie de ataque, sino por impacto legal y social directo.
entries.en: The AI Act does not classify by attack surface, but by direct legal and social impact.

entries.es: Muchos sistemas minimal risk son: accesibles públicamente, altamente escalables, integrados con datos externos, etc
entries.en: Many minimal-risk systems are publicly accessible, highly scalable, integrated with external data, etc.

entries.es: Marcos como NIST y ENISA muestran que muchos sistemas clasificados como minimal risk presentan superficies de ataque considerables, lo que justifica controles de seguridad adicionales aunque la regulación no los exija
entries.en: Frameworks such as NIST and ENISA show that many systems classified as minimal risk present considerable attack surfaces, which justifies additional security controls even if regulation does not require them.

entries.es: Unlike the AI Act, the NIST AI RMF does not define a minimal risk category. Risk is assessed based on technical exposure, data flows and attack surfaces, which means that many systems classified as minimal risk under the AI Act still require robust cybersecurity controls
entries.en: Unlike the AI Act, the NIST AI RMF does not define a minimal risk category. Risk is assessed based on technical exposure, data flows and attack surfaces, which means that many systems classified as minimal risk under the AI Act still require robust cybersecurity controls.

entries.es: Los sistemas no críticos desde el punto de vista legal pueden ser críticos desde el punto de vista de seguridad
entries.en: Systems that are not critical from a legal standpoint can be critical from a security standpoint.

entries.es: aplicar controles proporcionados a la exposición, no al sector.
entries.en: Apply controls proportional to exposure, not to sector.

entries.es: Data poisoning
entries.en: Data poisoning

entries.es: Introducción de datos maliciosos en entrenamiento o reentrenamiento para alterar el comportamiento del modelo.
entries.en: Introducing malicious data into training or retraining to alter the model's behaviour.

entries.es: Los sistemas minimal risk suelen entrenarse o ajustarse con datos abiertos, inputs de usuario o reentrenamiento continuo. Al no considerarse críticos, no se imponen controles estrictos sobre la calidad e integridad de los datos, lo que permite introducir datos maliciosos sin ser detectados.
entries.en: Minimal-risk systems are often trained or fine-tuned with open data, user inputs or continuous retraining. Because they are not considered critical, no strict controls are imposed on data quality and integrity, which allows malicious data to be introduced undetected.

entries.es: Prompt injection
entries.en: Prompt injection

entries.es: Manipulación del modelo mediante entradas diseñadas para eludir restricciones o cambiar su comportamiento.
entries.en: Manipulating the model through inputs designed to bypass restrictions or change its behaviour.

entries.es: Muchos sistemas minimal risk son interactivos (chatbots, ETC.). El modelo acepta instrucciones directas del usuario y no existe separación clara entre datos y control, lo que facilita que un atacante manipule el comportamiento del sistema mediante texto.
entries.en: Many minimal-risk systems are interactive (chatbots, etc.). The model accepts direct instructions from the user and there is no clear separation between data and control, which makes it easier for an attacker to manipulate the system's behaviour through text.

entries.es: Indirect prompt injection
entries.en: Indirect prompt injection

entries.es: El modelo ejecuta instrucciones ocultas dentro de datos externos (documentos, webs, emails).
entries.en: The model executes instructions hidden in external data (documents, websites, emails).

entries.es: Estos sistemas suelen integrarse con fuentes externas (documentos, etc). Al no considerarse de alto riesgo, no se filtra ni valida el contenido externo como potencial vector de ataque, permitiendo instrucciones ocultas que el modelo ejecuta sin distinguirlas de datos legítimos.
entries.en: These systems are often integrated with external sources (documents, etc.). Because they are not considered high-risk, external content is not filtered or validated as a potential attack vector, allowing hidden instructions that the model executes without distinguishing them from legitimate data.

entries.es: Model extraction / stealing
entries.en: Model extraction / stealing

entries.es: Reconstrucción parcial o total del modelo mediante consultas repetidas a la API.
entries.en: Partial or total reconstruction of the model through repeated queries to the API.

entries.es: Al tratarse de sistemas no críticos, se suelen exponer mediante APIs, con autenticación débil y sin límites estrictos. Esta accesibilidad facilita ataques por consultas repetidas para reconstruir el modelo.
entries.en: As non-critical systems, they are often exposed through APIs with weak authentication and without strict limits. This accessibility facilitates attacks using repeated queries to reconstruct the model.

entries.es: Membership inference
entries.en: Membership inference

entries.es: Inferir si un dato concreto fue usado en el entrenamiento.
entries.en: Inferring whether a specific data point was used in training.

entries.es: Muchos sistemas minimal risk usan datos reales de usuarios (texto, feedback) para mejorar el rendimiento. Al no estar clasificados como sensibles, no se aplican defensas avanzadas, permitiendo inferir si un dato concreto formó parte del entrenamiento.
entries.en: Many minimal-risk systems use real user data (text, feedback) to improve performance. Because they are not classified as sensitive, advanced defences are not applied, making it possible to infer whether a specific data point was part of the training set.

entries.es: Model inversion
entries.en: Model inversion

entries.es: Reconstrucción aproximada de datos de entrenamiento a partir de salidas del modelo.
entries.en: Approximate reconstruction of training data from the model's outputs.

entries.es: En modelos accesibles públicamente, las salidas detalladas facilita la reconstruircción de la información del entrenamiento, un riesgo no contemplado en la categoría minimal risk
entries.en: In publicly accessible models, detailed outputs make it easier to reconstruct training information, a risk not considered in the minimal-risk category.

entries.es: Carencias del AI Act
entries.en: AI Act gaps

entries.es: se contemplan los riesgos que no son fácilmente medibles en un entorno que está constantemente evolucionando. harm to people/harm to an organization/harm to an ecosystem pg5
entries.en: Risks that are not easily measurable in a constantly evolving environment are considered: harm to people, harm to an organisation, harm to an ecosystem (p. 5).
